BarChart

Bar chart in plain SVG: vertical or horizontal, grouped or stacked, with axes, legend, tooltips and an accessible data table.

Source src/react/charts/BarChart.tsx See it in the gallery

Example

Requests by region
regionAllowedBlocked
eu-central4,210312
eu-west1,650140
us-east3,020512
ap-south98096
Scroll →
tsx 
import { BarChart } from "@osqd/ui"; <BarChart  label="Requests by region"  height={220}  x="region"  series={[    { key: "allowed", label: "Allowed" },    { key: "blocked", label: "Blocked" },  ]}  data={[    { region: "eu-central", allowed: 4210, blocked: 312 },    { region: "eu-west", allowed: 1650, blocked: 140 },    { region: "us-east", allowed: 3020, blocked: 512 },    { region: "ap-south", allowed: 980, blocked: 96 },  ]}/>

Props

PropTypeDefaultDescription
orientation "vertical" | "horizontal" "vertical" "vertical" (columns, default) or "horizontal" (bars — better for long category names).
stacked boolean false Stack the series instead of grouping them side by side.
datarequired Row[] — —
xrequired keyof Row & string — The row field holding the category / x label.
seriesrequired ChartSeries[] — —
labelrequired string — Accessible name — what the chart shows, e.g. "Requests per hour, last 24 h".
height number 240 Plot height in px. Default 240.
legend boolean — Legend below the plot. Default: shown when there are two or more series.
table "hidden" | "toggle" "hidden" "hidden" (default) keeps the data table for screen readers only; "toggle" adds a visible "View as table".
format (value: number) => string — Format for tooltips and the table. Default: grouped number.
tickFormat (value: number) => string — Format for axis ticks. Default: compact (12.5K).
locale string — —
emptyText ReactNode — —

Also accepts every native <div> attribute, passed through to the root element.

CSS classes

The classes this component renders, for styling the same thing in plain HTML.

.oq-chart .oq-chart--bar .oq-chart__band .oq-chart__bar .oq-chart__grid .oq-chart__hit .oq-chart__hover .oq-chart__plot .oq-chart__svg .oq-chart__tick
